localFacts.fact: Canon Deutschland lists the PowerShot V1 at 426 g (CIPA, with battery and card), tripod socket 1/4 (ISO 1222), and 'Griffstativ HG-100TBR / HG-200TBR' as accessories with the note that camera and all accessories together should not exceed 1 kg.
Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg; the Peak Design Travel Tripod folds to 39 cm and fits by length.

Ryanair includes a small personal bag of 40 x 30 x 20 cm under the seat in every fare; all four minis (HG-100TBR 19 cm, PIXI Mini 18,5 cm, PIXI EVO 20,5 cm, MT-16 22 cm folded) are shorter than that bag.
Staatliche Museen zu Berlin: tripods (and bags over 30 x 20 x 10 cm) must be handed in at the cloakroom or put in a locker, so a mini tripod goes there too.
Humboldt Forum Berlin allows private photos, but tripods may not be used indoors.
German terms: Griffstativ, Tischstativ / Ministativ, Kugelkopf, Mittelsäule, Stativgewinde 1/4 Zoll, Blitzschuh; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: The ball head of a PIXI-type mini tripod does not hold the camera reliably in the locked position.
localPainPoints.fix: English post: lock the head with the camera's weight centred over it, or use the PIXI EVO's -90° side tilt for portrait; the PIXI EVO's 2,5 kg rating leaves more margin.

quotes.text: Ich suche eine Alternative zum Manfrotto Pixi, bei dem die Kamera zuverlässig in der Position bleibt, in der man den Gelenkkopf fixiert hat.

localPainPoints.pain: A small table tripod tips forward when the weight sits in front of it.
localPainPoints.fix: Turn one leg forward under the lens; the V1 is only 426 g and short, and the HG-100TBR / PIXI legs spread under it.

localPainPoints.pain: Tripods are banned or must go to the cloakroom in many German museums.
localPainPoints.fix: Check the house rules first (Staatliche Museen Berlin, Humboldt Forum); the V1's optical IS covers handheld shots there.

localGain.point: Canon Deutschland's own V1 figures (426 g, 1/4-Zoll-Gewinde) and its 1 kg total-weight note for the Griffstativ.
Ryanair 40 x 30 x 20 cm small bag fits every mini; Lufthansa 55 cm cabin bag fits the Peak Design.
Berlin museum tripod rules (Staatliche Museen cloakroom, Humboldt Forum no tripods indoors).
